name: Not just a stupid tradition
source:
You will play as Chloe, a curious and determined teenager who accompanies her best friend on a family trip to celebrate All Saints' Eve. What seems like a simple and boring generational tradition will soon turn into a struggle against the terrifying consequences of meddling with the forbidden.

Will they find a way to contain the evil before it is fully unleashed? 

[From [url=https://fiideogames.itch.io/not-just-a-stupid-tradition]Itch.io[/url]]
